Produces: Infinite damage; Infinite death triggers; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers

Steps: Cast Fiend Hunter by paying {1}{W}{W}.
  Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, exiling Crypt Champion.

  Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, returning Crypt Champion from exile to the battlefield.

  Repeat from step 2.
  Once you have a large amount of Goblin Bombardment triggers, you may stop the loop and deal infinite damage to any target(s).

Color identity: RWB | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite lifeloss; Infinite artifact tokens; Infinite lifegain triggers; Infinite Blood tokens; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers
Start: Darien, King of Kjeldor (battlefield); Havoc Jester (battlefield); Shilgengar, Sire of Famine (battlefield); Thunder of Unity (battlefield, graveyard)
Prerequisites: You control another creature.
  You have 2 or more life.
  Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
Steps: Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature.
  When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
  Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
  When the Soldier enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
  Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
  Repeat.

Prerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Steps: Cast Chance for Glory by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and to lose the game at the beginning of that turn's end step.
  Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Chance for Glory and putting it face down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
  During your next turn, deal combat damage to an opponent using the face down creature that has Chance for Glory noted.
  The creature triggers, casting a copy of Chance for Glory without paying its mana cost. Resolve the copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and to lose the game at the beginning of that turn's end step.
  Activate Sundial of the Infinite by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to end the turn. This will prevent the Chance for Glory trigger from causing you to lose the game.
  Repeat from step 3.

## Combo 3057-4192-5703

Color identity: RWB | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 75 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite combat damage; Infinite combat phases; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB
Start: Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad (battlefield); Bloodthirster (graveyard); Ashes of the Fallen (battlefield)
Prerequisites: "Assassin" chosen with Ashes of the Fallen.
  An opponent cannot block creatures you control.

Steps: Give Altaïr ib-La'Ahad vigilance by any method.
  Declare Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad as an attacker.
  Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad triggers, exiling Bloodthirster from your graveyard with a memory counter on it as it is an Assassin due to Ashes of the Fallen, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each creature you own in exile with a memory counter on it.
  Deal combat damage to an opponent using the Bloodthirster token.
  The Bloodthirster token triggers, causing you to untap it and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
  At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad triggers, exiling the Bloodthirster token.
  Move to your next combat phase, and declare Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad as an attacker.
  Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad triggers, creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each creature you own in exile with a memory counter on it.
  Repeat from step 4.

  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. Color identity: RWB | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 1 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite red mana; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers
Start: Brotherhood Outcast (battlefield); Thermopod (battlefield); Necrogen Communion (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Necrogen Communion attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Steps: Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
  When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
  Repeat.

## Combo 4775-6495-6553
Cards: Brotherhood Outcast + Evereth, Viceroy of Plunder + Necrogen Communion
Color identity: RWB | Bracket: 3-4+ (Spicy) | Popularity: 1 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite damage; Infinite +1/+1 counters on a creature; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers
Start: Brotherhood Outcast (battlefield); Evereth, Viceroy of Plunder (battlefield); Necrogen Communion (battlefield: attached to Brotherhood Outcast)
Steps: Activate Evereth by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
  When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
  Resolve the Evereth ability.
  Repeat.
Notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

## Combo 4779-4907-6972

Color identity: RWB | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite artifact ETB; Infinite artifact LTB; Infinite artifact sacrifice triggers; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers; Infinitely powerful creature until end of turn
Start: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight (battlefield); Tatterkite (battlefield); Krark-Clan Grunt (battlefield)

## Combo 4779-6835-6972
Cards: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight + Krark-Clan Grunt + Arcbound Overseer
Color identity: RWB | Bracket: 2-3+ (Oddball) | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite +1/+1 counters on certain creatures; Infinite artifact ETB; Infinite artifact LTB; Infinite artifact sacrifice triggers; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers; Infinitely powerful creature until end of turn
Start: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight (battlefield); Krark-Clan Grunt (battlefield); Arcbound Overseer (battlefield)
Steps: Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Arcbound Overseer.
  When Arcbound Overseer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
  Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Overseer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
  Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
  Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
  Repeat.
